items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I heard him on record, you know, with this fellow, they called him Whining Boy, Jelly Roll Martin? >> [INTERVIEWEE] With him and Freddie Capel.

ctx.x: I heard him on record, you know, with this fellow, they called him Whining Boy, Jelly Roll Martin?
No, just, Boccai was at it. Paul Barnes, Bolo was playing sax on some of the same records. Sidney Bashe, you heard him? Plenty. I met him once.
